parameters.content:
## Team Leave Requests + Owner Approvals
- Employee form: `/form/leave-request`
- Owner approvals page (keep private): `/webhook/leave-admin-CHANGE-ME-2`
- Counts working days (Mon–Fri), tracks the annual allowance (14 days, edit in **Build Approvals Page**), shows who is off in the next 7 days.
- Approve/Reject buttons post to `/webhook/leave-action-CHANGE-ME-2` and redirect back.
- Stored in workflow static data. No API keys or credentials required.

parameters.formDescription: Submit your leave request. Your manager will approve or reject it on the team approvals page.
